people.name: Mary Claire Johnson
people.calling: I was a nursing student feeling unsatisfied with my future career. I knew I had a passion to care for others and it was through varying mentorship/discipleship opportunities in college that I recognized my passion of long-term development and healing in both myself and others!

people.name: Matt Cluraghty
people.college: Moody Bible Institute; Bachelor of Science in Ministry with Leadership Emphasis
people.calling: Since God brought me into relationship with himself my senior year of high school, he has placed a deep passion in my heart for the lost. God proved that he would equip me for whatever he would call me for, and in my case that was full-time ministry. My passion is to be used by God to draw people close to Jesus.

people.name: Isaiah Lackey
people.college: Toccoa Falls College; Cross-Cultural Studies & Bible and Theology.
people.calling: My call to ministry has been a journey of going through doors the Lord opens for me and to using the gifts of the Spirit that he has given to me. The Lord has given me a heart and a passion for serving others in any capacity, especially those of different cultural backgrounds.
people.food: Any kind of Asian food, or Chick-fil-A.
people.drink: Mocha, Caramel Macchiato, or just a plain black cup of coffee.

people.name: Caitlin Bliss (Fettig)
people.calling: My call to ministry stems from my desire to leave people better than I found them by being the hands and feet of Christ to everyone I meet.
people.food: Cereal… just any and ALL of the cereal.

people.name: Lottie Lackey (Ellis)
people.college: Crown College; Youth & Family Ministry and Christian Studies
people.calling: God is continually revealing to me the beauty of himself, and the beauty in those around me. I feel called to empower people, through the love of Jesus, to share their stories and pursue him with their whole lives.

people.name: Matt Johnson
people.college: Florida Southern College; BA in Religion
people.calling: My call to ministry has been more of a fall to ministry. God has faithfully ruined all of my plans that did not align with his, and with my future freed of obligations, God made it clear that I was to build up the Church with the gifts I have been given.

people.name: Seth Renicks
people.college: Toccoa Falls College; B.S. in Ministry and Leadership
people.calling: Right now I’m called to be in the Residency program and learn as much as I can to be ready for where the Lord has me next!
